definitions.gloss: most important; of the highest importance; top priority
definitions.explanation: The superlative form of {重要|じゅうよう}, indicating something that is of the greatest significance or urgency among all options.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最重要|さいじゅうよう}だ。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最重要|さいじゅうよう}な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should tackle this as the most important issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{最重要|さいじゅうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲|かか}げた→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: At the meeting, they set customer satisfaction as the top-priority goal.

notes:
Formed by the superlative prefix ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ (most) + ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧ (important). Used as a pre-noun modifier with な or directly before a noun without な in more formal/written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最重要|さいじゅうよう}⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧: the most important issue
- {最重要|さいじゅうよう}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: top-priority item
- {最重要|さいじゅうよう}⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: the most important person
- {最重要|さいじゅうよう}⟦{拠点|きょてん}→拠点：05628_kyoten⟧: the most critical base/location

USAGE:
Often used with な when modifying a noun ({最重要|さいじゅうよう}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧), but in formal writing the な may be dropped ({最重要|さいじゅうよう}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧). Can also be used as a predicate: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最重要|さいじゅうよう}だ (X is the most important).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧: important (base form, without superlative)
- ⟦{最優先|さいゆうせん}→最優先：13012_saiyuusen⟧: highest priority (emphasizes order of action rather than inherent importance)
- ⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧: crucial, essential (more colloquial, focuses on what matters most in a practical sense)
